query: I have a 48‑year‑old female inpatient. In female admissions aged 43–53 with sepsis, what is the 25th‑percentile instability score (critical lab event count) in the first 72 hours? Report cohort and general mean critical events per admission, LOS, and mortality.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE category = 'Critical') THEN l.labevent_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.labevent_id), 0) AS instability_score, AVG(l.value) AS avg_severity, AVG(l.valueuom) AS avg_unit, AVG(i.length_of_stay) AS avg_length_of_stay, AVG(i.is_dead) AS avg_mortality FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN labevents l ON a.subject_id = l.subject_id JOIN icustays i ON a.subject_id = i.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, p.dob)) BETWEEN 43 AND 53 AND l.charttime BETWEEN a.admittime AND (a.dischtime - interval '72 hours') AND l.itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE category = 'Critical') GROUP BY p.gender, instability_score ORDER BY instability_score NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 25;
